# pidginhost_images (Data Source)

Operating system images available for new servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_images" "all" {}

locals {
  ubuntu = one([for image in data.pidginhost_images.all.images : image if image.slug == "ubuntu24"])
}

output "ubuntu_login" {
  value = local.ubuntu.default_username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Every image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `default_username` (String) Account the image provisions for SSH login.
- `family_name` (String) Operating system family, such as Ubuntu. Null when the image has none.
- `id` (String) Image id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default version within its family.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Short name of the image, accepted wherever an image is selected.
